statement: Prospective conservative production option before any evidence: keep all finest-control gates and last-three-mesh uncertainty rule unchanged. If512 qualifiesS2000, independently review fresh384 production measurements using absolute error allowance epsilon_production >= R_fine*u_fine + abs(R_fine-R384), plus any extra production-cadence uncertainty. This is triangle-inequality transport of the qualified finer envelope, never a relaxation; also compare against the direct384 error sum and use the larger. S1000 production384 remains its qualified finest mesh. All physical inputs and flux reducer unchanged. Request reviewer approval explicitly; do not execute evidence on this basis without it. Reduces duplicate solver cost while retaining finer-control information.
